title: Free trial doesn’t work – stuck on subscription screen
body: I downloaded the app and completed all the initial questions. It then prompted me to subscribe, so I opted for the free trial. Although it shows that I’ve subscribed, the app doesn’t move past the subscription screen. When I press the “Restore” button, it just takes me to a random page about the privacy policy. It seems like the only way to actually use the app is to pay, which defeats the point of offering a trial. I’m not comfortable paying for something I can’t even try. The app looks promising based on the screenshots—hopefully the developers fix this issue so users can experience it properly before committing to a purchase.
